counterbalance_slot.Description: Slot in the pre-generated permuted-block condition-order allocation (ExperimentConductor.ALLOCATION). Usually the participant number, but re-assigned to re-fill the slot of an excluded participant. The per-visit order itself is in scans.tsv (it crosses over between visits).

threshold_standing_deg.Description: Tilt giving ~75 % correct, from the standing calibration of the latest visit (each visit's calibration is in ses-01/beh).

threshold_walking_deg.Description: Tilt giving ~75 % correct, from the walking calibration of the latest visit (each visit's calibration is in ses-01/beh).

threshold_angle_deg.Description: Same as threshold_walking_deg (standing if there is no walking calibration); kept for older analysis scripts.

easy_angle_deg.Description: Same as easy_walking_deg; kept for older scripts.

hard_angle_deg.Description: Same as hard_walking_deg; kept for older scripts.
